title: Type Safety Follow-up — Browser and Wrangler helpers
archiveReason: The helper-level type-safety follow-up is complete: persistentBrowser and wranglerHelper now use unknown-plus-guard parsing instead of broad any-based helper flows, with behavior preserved and no additional follow-up track needed for this slice.
verificationNotes: Audit 2026-04-12: src/utils/persistentBrowser.ts and src/utils/wranglerHelper.ts both remain on the tightened type-safe shape described by the track, using BrowserResponse guards and unknown-based JSON parsing instead of broad any helper paths. Focused verification passed for npm run build, npm run build:ui, test/browserCopilotSessionService.test.ts, test/browserCopilotCommands.test.ts, and test/browser_rendering.test.ts; there is no dedicated wrangler helper unit test in the repo, but the archived plan explicitly treated build validation as sufficient for this helper-only slice.
